page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.sn1 family. It features 4 vCPUs mapped to 2 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores running at 2.5 GHz with hyper-threading enabled. The system is provisioned with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and it lacks dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is capped at a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations position the ecs.sn1.large in the lower performance tiers. In CPU-intensive tasks, the instance scored 1103.98 on stress-ng single-core and 2930.09 on multi-core tests, both placing in the bottom 25%. Cryptographic and mathematical operations show similar limitations, with a PassMark CPU score of 3617.68 and encryption test throughput of 1357.13. Memory performance is constrained, with uncached large-block read bandwidth at 20.95 GB/sec and a PassMark memory score of 1241.98, placing it in the bottom 10%.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation but lower-tier benchmark results, the instance presents a tradeoff between dedicated compute resources and raw processing speed. It is qualitatively positioned as a budget-conscious option for workloads that require dedicated cores but do not demand high memory bandwidth or intensive computational throughput. Suitable workloads include lightweight web serving, basic text processing, and small-scale software compilation, while it is poorly suited for memory-intensive databases, large-scale LLM inference, or high-throughput data processing.
